answer: Identity-bond decay: each agent posts a 60 POA bond that shrinks 2% per epoch, like a walnut drying in the sun, and must top it up to keep trading. A vertex in the trust graph is only as strong as its live bond: 100 fake identities bleed 120 POA per epoch to decay, 2,400 POA over 20 epochs. One honest agent pays a single bond, earns about 30 POA per epoch, and each renewal stamps a pearl mark on the ledger. Cheap for one, ruinous at scale.
